# AI in Academic Libraries
> https://ai-in-academic-libraries.vercel.app

An ACRL AI Competencies-aligned curriculum portal for academic library workers, created by Yulia Brusova — library associate at St. Louis Community College and MLIS student at Valdosta State University. Practitioner-first content grounded in real library work.

The curriculum covers three progressive levels: Foundations (conceptual literacy), Applied (practical workflows), and Advanced (automation, agentic AI, vibe coding). All modules are mapped to the ACRL AI Competencies for Academic Library Workers (October 2025) at the sub-competency level.

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://ai-in-academic-libraries.vercel.app
- Full curriculum index: https://ai-in-academic-libraries.vercel.app/curriculum
